title: 看懂激光切割，也看懂它的危险
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/01_Innovative Laser Cutting Industrial Jan2020SloMo MusicCam Vizion wwwPhoto.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/01_Innovative Laser Cutting Industrial Jan2020SloMo MusicCam Vizion wwwPhoto/src.py

points.K3: 切割头、压力表和格栅台
points.S1: 激光切割机的五类危险

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台封闭式激光切割机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large enclosed industrial laser cutting machine and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天来看激光切割，也看它的危险。
overlay: 看懂激光切割，也看懂它的危险

shots.scene: 金属零件、火花、烟雾、气瓶、警告标志五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a metal part, flying sparks, a smoke cloud, a gas cylinder, and a laser warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 零件很漂亮，背后有光、火、烟和气。

shots.scene: 工程训练中心里，阿杰举着手机凑近正在切割的机器，机门半开
shots.prompt_en: In an engineering training workshop, the young male student holds up a blank phone and leans toward a cutting machine whose door is half open.
shots.narration: 阿杰想凑近拍一段火花慢动作。

shots.scene: 人贴近切割区、门半开的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person leaning into an open cutting area with sparks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 门开着、人贴着，激光和火花都会伤人。

shots.scene: 老李按下暂停键，把阿杰带到黄线外
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses a pause button on the machine and guides the young male student back behind a yellow floor line.
shots.narration: 老李停下机器，把他请到黄线外。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先弄懂机器在干什么，再说怎么防。

shots.scene: 图纸上摆着几叠切好的垫片、连接板和方框件
shots.prompt_en: Several neat stacks of laser-cut metal parts on blank engineering drawings: round washers, long plates with holes, and square frame pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 激光切割能按图纸切出各种金属件。

shots.scene: 一叠形状完全相同的长条连接板
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a tall stack of identical metal strips with matching holes and chamfered ends. No people.
shots.narration: 成批切出，大小、孔位都一样。

shots.scene: 小研拿起一个垫片，与旁边的图纸比对
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up a metal washer and compares it with a blank drawing on the bench.
shots.narration: 适合做小批量的定制零件。

shots.scene: 示意图：一束光从切割头向下聚成一点，落在钢板上
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a light beam inside a cutting head narrows down to a bright focal point on a steel sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 激光在切割头下聚成很小的一点。

shots.scene: 钢板上的亮点处金属熔化，气流向下吹出熔渣
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section diagram: metal melts at the bright spot and a downward gas stream blows molten droplets through the cut. No people.
shots.narration: 金属被熔化，再被气流从切口吹走。

shots.scene: 慢动作：切割头下火花向四周飞溅，设备护罩关闭
shots.prompt_en: Slow motion inside a closed machine enclosure: orange sparks spray outward from under the cutting head. No people.
shots.narration: 所以切割时火花四溅，温度极高。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着火花图标，旁边一只眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a sparks icon next to an eye icon.
shots.narration: 亮光和火花，提醒我们这里有危险。

shots.section_title: 切割头、压力表和格栅台
shots.scene: 切割头特写：机头上有一块圆形压力表
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a cutting head with a round analog pressure gauge with a blank dial. No people.
shots.narration: 切割头旁的压力表，显示辅助气体压力。
overlay: 切割头、压力表和格栅台

shots.section_title: 切割头、压力表和格栅台
shots.scene: 钢板平放在一排排带长条孔的格栅台面上
shots.prompt_en: A steel sheet lies flat on a slatted grid table with rows of long slots. No people.
shots.narration: 板材放在格栅台上，下面留出排渣空间。

shots.section_title: 切割头、压力表和格栅台
shots.scene: 机身一侧的折叠风琴罩随机头移动伸缩
shots.prompt_en: A folding bellows cover on the side of the machine stretches and compresses as the head moves. No people.
shots.narration: 风琴罩护着导轨，挡住火花和碎渣。

shots.scene: L形金属支架表面刻着空白图标和一串点线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of an L-shaped steel bracket with a laser-engraved blank logo shape and a dotted line pattern, no readable text. No people.
shots.narration: 激光还能在零件上打标。

shots.scene: 一个零件上的编号图标，连到一本空白记录册
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a part with an engraved number shape linked by an arrow to a blank record book. No people.
shots.narration: 刻上标记和编号，以后好查好追溯。

shots.scene: 老李把切好的零件按批码放，逐件对照图纸
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stacks finished parts in batches and checks each against a blank drawing.
shots.narration: 切完的零件按批码放，对照图纸检查。

shots.section_title: 激光切割机的五类危险
shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光切割机前，身后浮现五个危险图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a laser cutting machine with five hazard icons floating behind.
shots.narration: 激光切割机至少有五类危险。
overlay: 激光切割机的五类危险

shots.section_title: 激光切割机的五类危险
shots.scene: 眼睛和皮肤图标旁有一道光束
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an eye and a hand next to a straight light beam. No people.
shots.narration: 一是激光，伤眼睛也伤皮肤。

shots.section_title: 激光切割机的五类危险
shots.scene: 火花落在纸箱和碎布上冒烟
shots.prompt_en: Sparks landing on a cardboard box and rags, which begin to smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 二是火花和高温，会引起火灾。

shots.section_title: 激光切割机的五类危险
shots.scene: 切割区上方飘起灰色烟尘
shots.prompt_en: Gray fumes rising above a cutting area. No people.
shots.narration: 三是切割烟尘，吸进去伤肺。

shots.section_title: 激光切割机的五类危险
shots.scene: 气瓶和电闪图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder icon next to an electrical high voltage icon. No people.
shots.narration: 四是高压气体，五是高压电。

shots.scene: 激光警告标志的大图标
shots.prompt_en: A large laser warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 看到这个标志，就要提高警惕。

shots.scene: 从低到高的几级台阶，最高一级亮红灯
shots.prompt_en: A staircase of levels from low to high, the top step glowing red, no text. No people.
shots.narration: 激光按危险分级，切割用的激光属最高级。

shots.scene: 王老师指着门上的激光警告标志和空白说明牌
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a laser warning sign and a blank information plate on a workshop door.
shots.narration: 具体分类和标识，以现行国家标准为准。

shots.scene: 封闭的机器外壳和关好的观察门
shots.prompt_en: A fully enclosed laser cutting machine with its access door closed and a dark viewing window. No people.
shots.narration: 外壳和观察窗，把激光关在机器里面。

shots.scene: 门一打开，激光图标自动熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: when the machine door opens, a laser icon switches off automatically. No people.
shots.narration: 门一开，联锁就让激光停下来。

shots.scene: 胶带缠住门联锁开关的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of tape wrapped around a door interlock switch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不准短接联锁，不准开门运行。

shots.scene: 人在机器旁举手机拍摄的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person holding a phone close to an open cutting area, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 想拍照，也只隔着观察窗拍。

shots.scene: 两副颜色不同的防护眼镜，旁边各有不同的波长图标
shots.prompt_en: Two pairs of laser safety goggles with different tinted lenses, each next to a different wave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不同激光，波长不同，眼镜也不同。

shots.scene: 小研翻看眼镜框上的空白标记，与机器铭牌比对
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank marking on goggle frames against a blank nameplate on the machine.
shots.narration: 按波长和光密度选，核对标记再戴。

shots.scene: 普通墨镜图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of ordinary sunglasses, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 墨镜、普通护目镜都挡不住激光。

shots.scene: 机器后方的排烟管通向过滤装置
shots.prompt_en: A fume extraction duct runs from the back of the cutting machine to a filter unit. No people.
shots.narration: 切割产生烟尘，排烟除尘必须开着。

shots.scene: 老李查看过滤器指示灯，更换空白滤芯
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the indicator light on a filter unit and replaces a blank filter cartridge.
shots.narration: 过滤器按时检查，堵了就停机。

shots.scene: 涂层板、塑料板图标旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a coated metal sheet and a plastic sheet next to a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不明材料不乱切，先问清成分。

shots.scene: 气瓶用链条固定在墙边的气瓶架上
shots.prompt_en: Gas cylinders secured with chains in a wall rack next to the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 辅助气体多来自高压气瓶。

shots.scene: 老李检查气瓶阀门和管路接头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a cylinder valve and hose connection with a leak test bottle.
shots.narration: 气瓶要固定，管路接头要定期查漏。

shots.scene: 氧气瓶图标旁的油污手套，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an oxygen cylinder next to an oily glove, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气瓶附近严禁油脂和明火。

shots.scene: 刚切好的零件冒着热气，边缘有毛刺
shots.prompt_en: Freshly cut metal parts with slight heat haze and sharp burred edges. No people.
shots.narration: 刚切好的零件又烫又锋利。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上防割手套，等零件冷却后再取
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on cut-resistant gloves and waits before lifting a cooled part from the table.
shots.narration: 等冷却，戴防割手套再取件。

shots.scene: 伸手到运行中切割台上取件的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand reaching into a running cutting table, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 机器没停稳，手不能伸进去。

shots.scene: 王老师给几名学生上培训课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a small group of students in front of a laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 切割机要先培训考核，再授权使用。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白登记本上签字，拿到空白授权卡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank logbook and receives a blank authorization card.
shots.narration: 用前登记，不熟悉的设备不碰。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现关门、眼镜、排烟、气瓶、手套、证书六个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside six icons: a closed door, safety goggles, a fume duct, a gas cylinder, gloves, and a certificate.
shots.narration: 关门运行、对波长、开排烟、管好气。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴着防护眼镜站在黄线外，隔着观察窗看切割
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing laser safety goggles, stands behind a yellow line and watches cutting through a closed viewing window.
shots.narration: 取件戴手套，培训授权再上机。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研、老李在切割机旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student, the female graduate student and the facility engineer beside the closed laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 看清危险，切出好零件。
